title: 14th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/14/3/2025).
From the Speaker's desk: presentation of the proposed state budget for 2026 to Parliament, as required by Article 96(a) of the Constitution.

summary: This short afternoon sitting was scheduled solely for the government's proposed 2026 state budget to be presented to Parliament.
